title: Array Nesting Length
description: The array `nums` is a permutation of the integers from 0 through `n - 1`. Starting at index `i`, repeatedly visit the index named by the current value: `i, nums[i], nums[nums[i]], ...`. Return the largest number of distinct indices visited before a cycle repeats. Input: the permutation `nums`. Output: the maximum cycle length.
constraints: nums is a permutation of [0, nums.length - 1]
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
